page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-192-lssd is a high-density compute instance powered by the Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 192 virtual CPUs mapped to 96 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a base frequency of 2.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 720 GB of system memory, providing a resource ratio of 3.75 GB per vCPU. Storage is bundled directly with the instance, consisting of 32 local NVMe SSDs that deliver a combined capacity of 12,599 GB. The CPU architecture includes advanced instruction sets such as Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512), which accelerate matrix multiplication and vector operations.

In benchmark evaluations, the multi-core capabilities of this instance rank in the top tier (top 10%), as demonstrated by a stress-ng multi-core score of 208,109.69 and a Passmark CPU score of 154,353.09. Conversely, single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core scoring in the middle 50% at 2,296.5. Memory subsystem performance is highly efficient, achieving top-tier read bandwidths of 15,326.29 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 711.18 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Database and transactional workloads perform exceptionally well, with Redis SET operations reaching 329.28 million operations per second and Passmark database operations placing in the top 10%. Large-scale static web serving throughput also reaches the top tier at 173.18 GB/sec.

The hardware profile offers high qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that can fully exploit massive parallelization and local NVMe storage, reducing the need for external network-attached storage. However, the moderate single-core performance represents a tradeoff for applications reliant on single-threaded execution. For machine learning, the onboard Intel AMX instructions support strong prompt processing speeds, such as 274.16 tokens per second on a 7B LLM, though text generation on larger 70B models drops to an average tier of 5.02 tokens per second due to the absence of dedicated GPU hardware. This instance is best suited for high-throughput database systems, large-scale software compilation, parallel data processing, and high-concurrency web serving.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-192-lssd is an x86_64 compute instance featuring 192 vCPUs across 96 physical Intel Xeon 6985P-C cores, 720 GB of RAM, and 12,599 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It lacks dedicated GPUs but incorporates Intel AMX and AVX-512 instruction sets. Benchmarks show top-tier multi-core CPU performance, high memory read bandwidth of up to 15,326.29 GB/sec, and exceptional database throughput, with Redis SET operations reaching 329.28 million operations per second. Single-core performance remains in the average tier. Qualitatively, the bundled local storage and high core density offer strong cost efficiency for parallelized, I/O-heavy workloads. This instance is highly suited for high-concurrency database operations, large-scale software compilation, and parallel data processing pipelines.
